newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate eases 30 bps to 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate eases 30 bps to 8.2 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average lending rate eased 30 basis points to 8.2 percent on Wednesday as lenders rolled over previous borrowings amid a lack of fresh demand for funds.
Zagreb's money market trade totalled a meagre 6.2 million kuna, dealers said.
Insurers' short-term rate was steady at seven percent and one interbank 15-30 day loan was rolled over at 10 percent.
Some 34 million kuna were settled in Tuesday's overnight trade as two banks borrowed money to square positions.

The central bank had no hard currency operations today. It quoted the kuna mid-rates for Thursday at 5.3613 versus 5.3822 to the dollar and 3.5590 from 3.5601 against the mark. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
